trigger.description: The managed block's recorded content hash (the hash= attribute on the begin marker) no longer matches the block body: someone hand-edited inside the markers since the last export. Export refuses to overwrite the edit without --force-managed-block; when forced, the pre-mutation content including the hand edit is preserved in the .ee-backup sibling (ADR 0065 §5/§6). diag agentsmd-drift reports the same condition read-only as hashMatches=false.
setup_commands: ee remember 'Always run the verify script before pushing changes to main.' --workspace . --level procedural --kind rule --json
printf 'sneaky hand edit inside the managed block\n' >> AGENTS.md  # then move the line inside the markers

notes: The refusal is the contract working, not a failure: hand edits inside the markers are presumed intentional until a human (or a reviewing agent) confirms otherwise via --dry-run and then --force-managed-block. Content outside the markers is never at risk.
